**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation running against Sanofi. I ran document-wide searches across the standard MFN formulations — "most favored/favoured", "no less favorable/favourable", "at least as favo…", "best terms", "comparable terms", "preferential", "match", "right of first" — all returned zero hits, then read Article IX (Financial Provisions) in full to confirm by direct inspection.

The economics are all fixed, closed-ended figures: a $50M upfront, milestones capped at $520M, tiered royalties with defined reduction mechanics and a royalty floor, and a 50/50 U.S. profit/loss share. Nothing obliges Sanofi to extend RevMed terms no less favourable than those given to any Third Party, or to match a third-party offer. There is likewise no vendor-granted MFN in our favour to preserve.

This sits at the playbook's **preferred** position (no MFN obligation on the Customer), so no redline is warranted.
